upgrades.label: Core Protocol
upgrades.description: Starting upgrade. Unlocks adjacent branches in the skill tree.

upgrades.label: Unlock Factory Tier
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Factory building.

upgrades.label: Unlock Mega-Complex
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Mega-Complex building.

upgrades.label: Turret Targeting Suite
upgrades.description: Auto-Turret and Siege Cannon gain range and damage.

upgrades.label: Generator Efficiency
upgrades.description: Generators produce 25% more power.

upgrades.label: Unlock Repair Bay
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Repair Bay.

upgrades.label: Unlock Reconstruction Yard
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Reconstruction Yard.

upgrades.label: Unlock Grid Expansion
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Large Generator and Large Battery.

upgrades.label: Unlock Pylon Network
upgrades.description: Unlocks Pylon structures.

upgrades.label: Unlock Nuclear Plant
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Nuclear Plant.

upgrades.label: Unlock Heavy Turrets
upgrades.description: Unlocks larger and specialized turret/cannon platforms.

upgrades.label: Unlock Railgun
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Railgun defense platform.

upgrades.label: Turret Range I
upgrades.description: All turrets gain a moderate range increase.

upgrades.label: Turret Range II
upgrades.description: All turrets gain a large range increase.

upgrades.label: Turret Damage I
upgrades.description: All turrets gain a moderate damage increase.

upgrades.label: Turret Damage II
upgrades.description: All turrets gain a large damage increase.

upgrades.label: Unlock Silo Tech
upgrades.description: Unlocks retargeting silo platforms.

upgrades.label: Unlock Nuclear Silo
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Nuclear Silo platform.

upgrades.label: Unlock Hydra Launcher
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Hydra burst launcher.

upgrades.label: Missile Payload I
upgrades.description: Improves explosive payload radius for non-Hydra missiles.

upgrades.label: Missile Payload II
upgrades.description: Further improves explosive payload radius and damage.

upgrades.label: Unlock Shield Generator
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Medium Shield Generator.

upgrades.label: Unlock Large Shield
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Large Shield Generator.

upgrades.label: Shield Capacity I
upgrades.description: Increases shield field maximum health.

upgrades.label: Shield Capacity II
upgrades.description: Greatly increases shield field maximum health.

upgrades.label: Shield Recharge I
upgrades.description: Increases shield recharge rate (still costs power to recharge).

upgrades.label: Plasma Focus I
upgrades.description: Plasma lasers gain damage and range.

upgrades.label: Plasma Focus II
upgrades.description: Plasma lasers gain more damage and become slightly more power efficient.

upgrades.label: Tesla Coils I
upgrades.description: Tesla tower zaps farther and hits harder.

upgrades.label: Logistics I
upgrades.description: Supply structures provide more maximum supply.

upgrades.label: Logistics II
upgrades.description: Supply structures provide significantly more maximum supply.

upgrades.label: Command Autonomy I
upgrades.description: Command Centers generate more credits and power.

upgrades.label: Structural Fortification I
upgrades.description: All structural buildings gain health.

upgrades.label: Structural Fortification II
upgrades.description: Further improves structural durability.

upgrades.label: Structural Auto-Repair
upgrades.description: All buildings passively repair up to 50% max health over time.

upgrades.label: Battery Capacity I
upgrades.description: Batteries increase max power storage more.

upgrades.label: Battery Capacity II
upgrades.description: Batteries greatly increase max power storage.

upgrades.label: Power Distribution I
upgrades.description: Energy weapons and missiles consume less power.

upgrades.label: Power Distribution II
upgrades.description: Further reduces power usage for high-tech systems.

upgrades.label: Nuclear Overclock I
upgrades.description: Nuclear plants generate more power (still require credits to run).

upgrades.label: Economy Optimization I
upgrades.description: Economy buildings produce more credits.

upgrades.label: Economy Optimization II
upgrades.description: Further improves economy building output.

upgrades.label: Unlock Refinery
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Refinery building.

upgrades.label: Unlock Mega Refinery
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Mega Refinery building.

upgrades.label: Command Center Level 2
upgrades.description: Command Centers provide more supply, power, and credits.

upgrades.label: Supply Depot (S) Level 2
upgrades.description: Small supply depots provide more supply.

upgrades.label: Supply Depot (L) Level 2
upgrades.description: Large supply depots provide more supply.

upgrades.label: Repair Bay Level 2
upgrades.description: Repair drones heal faster and launch more frequently.

upgrades.label: Support Node Level 2
upgrades.description: Support Node pulses heal more and cover more range.

upgrades.label: Reconstruction Yard Level 2
upgrades.description: Reconstruction Yards can rebuild from farther away.

upgrades.label: Business Level 2
upgrades.description: Businesses generate more credits.

upgrades.label: Factory Level 2
upgrades.description: Factories generate more credits.

upgrades.label: Mega-Complex Level 2
upgrades.description: Mega-Complexes generate significantly more credits.

upgrades.label: Refinery Level 2
upgrades.description: Refineries output more credits with slightly better efficiency.

upgrades.label: Mega Refinery Level 2
upgrades.description: Mega Refineries output more credits with slightly better efficiency.

upgrades.label: Chemical Installation Level 2
upgrades.description: Chemical installations produce more credits.

upgrades.label: Generator (S) Level 2
upgrades.description: Small generators produce more power.

upgrades.label: Generator (L) Level 2
upgrades.description: Large generators produce more power.

upgrades.label: Battery (S) Level 2
upgrades.description: Small batteries provide more max power storage.

upgrades.label: Battery (L) Level 2
upgrades.description: Large batteries provide more max power storage.

upgrades.label: Pylon Level 2
upgrades.description: Pylons generate more network power.

upgrades.label: Nuclear Plant Level 2
upgrades.description: Nuclear plants output more power and drain fewer credits.

upgrades.label: Auto-Turret Level 2
upgrades.description: Auto-Turrets fire faster and hit harder.

upgrades.label: Auto-Turret (L) Level 2
upgrades.description: Large Auto-Turrets fire faster and hit harder.

upgrades.label: Siege Cannon Level 2
upgrades.description: Siege Cannons gain range and heavy-shot damage.

upgrades.label: Heavy Siege Cannon Level 2
upgrades.description: Heavy Siege Cannons gain range and heavy-shot damage.

upgrades.label: AA Gun Level 2
upgrades.description: AA Guns gain per-shot damage and larger blast radius.

upgrades.label: Railgun Level 2
upgrades.description: Railguns gain range and much higher beam damage.

upgrades.label: Missile Launcher (S) Level 2
upgrades.description: Small missile launchers fire faster and hit harder.

upgrades.label: Missile Launcher (M) Level 2
upgrades.description: Medium missile launchers fire faster and hit harder.

upgrades.label: Portable Silo Level 2
upgrades.description: Portable silos gain range, damage, and blast radius.

upgrades.label: Missile Silo Level 2
upgrades.description: Missile silos gain range, damage, and blast radius.

upgrades.label: Nuclear Silo Level 2
upgrades.description: Nuclear silos gain extreme range and payload damage.

upgrades.label: Hydra Launcher Level 2
upgrades.description: Hydra launchers fire faster and boost volley damage.

upgrades.label: Shield Generator (M) Level 2
upgrades.description: Medium shields gain capacity and recharge performance.

upgrades.label: Shield Generator (L) Level 2
upgrades.description: Large shields gain capacity and recharge performance.

upgrades.label: Tesla Tower Level 2
upgrades.description: Tesla towers zap harder and farther.

upgrades.label: Plasma Laser (S) Level 2
upgrades.description: Small plasma lasers gain beam damage and range.

upgrades.label: Plasma Laser (M) Level 2
upgrades.description: Medium plasma lasers gain beam damage and range.

upgrades.label: Plasma Laser (L) Level 2
upgrades.description: Large plasma lasers gain beam damage and range.

upgrades.label: Archangel Logistic Core
upgrades.description: Unlocks Airfield, Starport, Fueling Station, Munitions Plant, and Missile Factory. Bulk Fueling requires a separate unlock.

upgrades.label: Unlock Bulk Fueling Station
upgrades.description: Unlocks the large Bulk Fueling Station for faster pad refueling.

upgrades.label: Increase Fuel Efficiency I
upgrades.description: Fueling stations transfer aviation fuel to landed planes faster.

upgrades.label: Increase Fuel Efficiency II
upgrades.description: Further improves fuel transfer rate to aircraft on the pad.

upgrades.label: Armor Piercing Rounds
upgrades.description: Increases Airfield gunship damage.

upgrades.label: Quick Reload
upgrades.description: Starport bombers reload volleys faster (shorter gap between missiles and between volleys).

upgrades.label: Tight Shift
upgrades.description: Each Airfield and Starport runs two planes: more sorties and overlapping refuel cycles.

upgrades.label: Airfield Level 2
upgrades.description: Gunship platform: more range, damage, and rate of fire.

upgrades.label: Starport Level 2
upgrades.description: Bomber platform: heavier warheads and slightly faster launches.

upgrades.label: Fueling Station Level 2
upgrades.description: Small fuel stations fuel landed aircraft faster.

upgrades.label: Bulk Fueling Level 2
upgrades.description: Bulk fuel stations fuel landed aircraft faster.

upgrades.label: Munitions Plant Level 2
upgrades.description: Munitions plants convert credits into gunship rounds faster while planes are on the pad.

upgrades.label: Missile Factory Level 2
upgrades.description: Missile factories load bomber ordnance faster while bombers are on the pad.

upgrades.label: Missile Doctrine: Damage I
upgrades.description: Increases damage for standard missile buildings (S/M silos, portable, silo, nuclear, Hydra).

upgrades.label: Missile Doctrine: Damage II
upgrades.description: Further increases missile damage across the missile line.

upgrades.label: Missile Doctrine: Range I
upgrades.description: Increases engagement range for missile platforms.

upgrades.label: Missile Doctrine: Range II
upgrades.description: Further increases missile range.

upgrades.label: Missile Doctrine: Payload I
upgrades.description: Improves blast radius for missile buildings (Hydra gains fire rate).

upgrades.label: Missile Doctrine: Payload II
upgrades.description: Further improves payload radius and adds a touch of damage.

upgrades.label: Dominion Command Mandate
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Defensive Bunker and Support Bay.

upgrades.label: Unlock Elite Weaponry
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Orbital Cannon and Flak Gun.

upgrades.label: Unlock Advanced Tech
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Seeker Drone Spawner and Laser Drill.

upgrades.label: Extended Support
upgrades.description: Support Bays can deploy up to two dropships at once.

upgrades.label: Enhanced Power
upgrades.description: All Dominion structures deal additional damage.

upgrades.label: Reinforced Plating
upgrades.description: All Dominion structures gain increased maximum health.

upgrades.label: Lead Rounds
upgrades.description: Orbital and Flak shrapnel counts are 50% higher (18 and 6 shards).

upgrades.label: Orbital Cannon Level 2
upgrades.description: Larger blast, harder hit, slightly faster cycle.

upgrades.label: Flak Gun Level 2
upgrades.description: More range, damage, and rate of fire.

upgrades.label: Defensive Bunker Level 2
upgrades.description: Bunker gains durability and punch.

upgrades.label: Seeker Spawner Level 2
upgrades.description: Drones launch faster and hit harder.

upgrades.label: Laser Drill Level 2
upgrades.description: Stronger beam and longer reach.

upgrades.label: Support Bay Level 2
upgrades.description: Dropships heal faster and fly quicker.

upgrades.label: Turret Battery: Damage I
upgrades.description: Increases damage for standard turrets.

upgrades.label: Turret Battery: Damage II
upgrades.description: Further increases turret damage.

upgrades.label: Turret Battery: Range I
upgrades.description: Increases engagement range for turrets.

upgrades.label: Turret Battery: Range II
upgrades.description: Further increases turret range.

upgrades.label: Turret Battery: Cycle I
upgrades.description: Increases turret rate of fire.

upgrades.label: Turret Battery: Cycle II
upgrades.description: Further increases turret cadence.

upgrades.label: Nova Command Mandate
upgrades.description: Unlocks Gravity Well, Photon Projector (S), and Power Bank.

upgrades.label: Unlock Advanced Weaponry
upgrades.description: Unlocks Photon Projector (L) and the Shockwave Pulsar.

upgrades.label: Unlock Universal Forcefield
upgrades.description: Unlocks the map-wide Universal Forcefield (one per run).

upgrades.label: Shield Implosion
upgrades.description: When a shield generator or Universal Forcefield bubble is fully depleted by an asteroid, it releases a huge low-damage pulse.

upgrades.label: Energized Power Bank
upgrades.description: Power Banks also grant a small damage bonus to weapons in their aura.

upgrades.label: Fission Blast
upgrades.description: Photon orbs detonate in a large blast when their flight time ends.

upgrades.label: Stasis Surge
upgrades.description: Shockwave Pulsar hits briefly lock asteroids in place.

upgrades.label: Gravity Well Level 2
upgrades.description: Sturdier well core; slightly lower idle power draw.

upgrades.label: Photon Projector (S) Level 2
upgrades.description: Tighter emitter cycle, harder hits, and longer reach for the small projector.

upgrades.label: Photon Projector (L) Level 2
upgrades.description: Heavy orb variant: more damage, wider trail burn, and punch-through speed.

upgrades.label: Shockwave Pulsar Level 2
upgrades.description: Wider concussion front with a faster pulse cadence.

upgrades.label: Universal Forcefield Level 2
upgrades.description: Raises global barrier capacity and slightly extends coverage.

upgrades.label: Power Bank Level 2
upgrades.description: Larger coupling field: wider efficiency aura and tougher hardware.

upgrades.label: Energy Doctrine: Yield I
upgrades.description: Boosts output from Tesla towers, plasma lasers, and Nova energy weapons.

upgrades.label: Energy Doctrine: Yield II
upgrades.description: Further raises energy-weapon damage across the grid.

upgrades.label: Energy Doctrine: Reach I
upgrades.description: Extends range on standard energy turrets and Nova emitters.

upgrades.label: Energy Doctrine: Reach II
upgrades.description: Additional reach for Tesla, plasma, and Nova platforms.

upgrades.label: Energy Doctrine: Cycle I
upgrades.description: Improves fire rate on directed energy and shock systems.

upgrades.label: Energy Doctrine: Cycle II
upgrades.description: Further tightens energy-weapon cadence.

upgrades.label: Citadel Mandate
upgrades.description: Deploy basic conduits: Defense, Attack, and Range.

upgrades.label: Unlock Advanced Conduits
upgrades.description: Unlocks Repair, Construction, and Efficiency Conduits.

upgrades.label: Citadel Structural Grid I
upgrades.description: Hardens core support structures.

upgrades.label: Citadel Structural Grid II
upgrades.description: Further reinforces support infrastructure.

upgrades.label: Command Fortress
upgrades.description: Command Centers gain significantly more max health.

upgrades.label: Conduit Integrity
upgrades.description: All Citadel Conduits are harder to destroy.

upgrades.label: Supply Lines
upgrades.description: Improves supply depots for expanded logistics.

upgrades.label: Industrial Shell
upgrades.description: Reinforces early economy buildings.

upgrades.label: Repair Conduit Level 2
upgrades.description: Repair Conduits pulse faster and heal more per pulse.

upgrades.label: Construction Conduit Level 2
upgrades.description: Larger discount aura and wider coordination radius (tuned in conduit logic).

upgrades.label: Defense Conduit Level 2
upgrades.description: Stronger damage reduction and wider ward (tuned in conduit logic).

upgrades.label: Attack Conduit Level 2
upgrades.description: Higher damage amp for nearby defenses (tuned in conduit logic).

upgrades.label: Efficiency Conduit Level 2
upgrades.description: Faster cadence boost for surrounding weapons (tuned in conduit logic).

upgrades.label: Range Conduit Level 2
upgrades.description: Additional reach granted to covered defenses (tuned in conduit logic).

upgrades.label: Defense Centers
upgrades.description: Each Command Center mounts an integrated turret (~2× Auto Turret), no power draw.

upgrades.label: Enhanced Conductivity
upgrades.description: Increases the aura radius of all Citadel Conduits.

upgrades.label: Sophisticated Repairs
upgrades.description: All healing sources are more potent (nodes, conduits, drones, hangar ops).

upgrades.label: Last Stand
upgrades.description: When only one Command Center remains, it takes less damage and regenerates slowly.

upgrades.label: Focused Power
upgrades.description: Multiple conduits of the same type can stack their benefits (capped).

upgrades.label: Jupiter Directive
upgrades.description: Jupiter structures are gated behind specialized unlock research.

upgrades.label: Unlock Support Machines
upgrades.description: Unlocks Overclock Augment, Radar Station, and Recon Drone.

upgrades.label: Unlock Advanced Electrical Solutions
upgrades.description: Unlocks Mass Relay and Battery Complex.

upgrades.label: Unlock Arc Thrower
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Arc Thrower.

upgrades.label: Grid Tuning I
upgrades.description: Generators and Mass Relays run a little cleaner.

upgrades.label: Grid Tuning II
upgrades.description: Further improves baseline electrical output.

upgrades.label: Capacitance Matrix I
upgrades.description: Batteries and the Battery Complex store more headroom.

upgrades.label: Capacitance Matrix II
upgrades.description: Adds even more grid reserve.

upgrades.label: Transmission Lines
upgrades.description: Pylon network bonus is stronger (global pylon synergy).

upgrades.label: Emergency Shunts
upgrades.description: Radar and Arc Thrower shot draws are slightly cheaper.

upgrades.label: Induction Weave
upgrades.description: Recon Drone coil is more efficient; Overclock draws a little less.

upgrades.label: Mass Relay Level 2
upgrades.description: Relays are tougher and idle draw drops further.

upgrades.label: Arc Thrower Level 2
upgrades.description: Arc thrower reaches farther and hits harder per tier.

upgrades.label: Overclock Augment Level 2
upgrades.description: Stronger fire-rate boost to neighbors.

upgrades.label: Radar Station Level 2
upgrades.description: Wider scan volume.

upgrades.label: Recon Drone Level 2
upgrades.description: More reach and coil damage; stronger induction below.

upgrades.label: Battery Complex Level 2
upgrades.description: Larger reserve and stronger low-power production curve.

upgrades.label: Enhanced Pinging Systems
upgrades.description: Radar Station marks more targets and keeps paint up longer.

upgrades.label: Emergency Generator
upgrades.description: When your stored energy hits empty, Battery Complex output surges briefly.

upgrades.label: Arc Supercharge
upgrades.description: Arc Thrower can spend extreme energy for a devastating top-tier chain.

upgrades.label: Kingpin Directive
upgrades.description: Syndicate structures are gated behind specialized unlock research.

upgrades.label: Unlock Advanced Economic Solutions
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Data Array and Investment Complex.

upgrades.label: Unlock Production Enhancements
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Cryptographic Decoder, Indoctrinated Labor, and Mineral Processor.

upgrades.label: Unlock Slag Cannon
upgrades.description: Unlocks the Slag Cannon.

upgrades.label: Preferred Stock I
upgrades.description: Factory output adds more credits per payout.

upgrades.label: Preferred Stock II
upgrades.description: Megacomplex lines and smaller factories scale further.

upgrades.label: Commodity Futures I
upgrades.description: Standard refineries ship more product.

upgrades.label: Commodity Futures II
upgrades.description: Mega refineries catch up to premium contracts.

upgrades.label: Venture Capital
upgrades.description: Command dividend ticks are stronger.

upgrades.label: Energy Arbitrage
upgrades.description: Generators and pylon networks squeeze out a little more juice.

upgrades.label: Data Array Level 2
upgrades.description: Tougher arrays with faster cycles and sharper payouts.

upgrades.label: Investment Complex Level 2
upgrades.description: Larger footprint yields; modest efficiency gain.

upgrades.label: Cryptographic Decoder Level 2
upgrades.description: Wider decoding field with stronger refinery yield.

upgrades.label: Indoctrinated Labor Level 2
upgrades.description: Labor camps reach farther across the factory floor.

upgrades.label: Mineral Processor Level 2
upgrades.description: Longer salvage reach for asteroid kills.

upgrades.label: Slag Cannon Level 2
upgrades.description: Heavier slugs with a touch more cadence; marginally cheaper ammunition.

upgrades.label: Hazard Pay
upgrades.description: Clearing waves grants credits; bonus grows with waves completed.

upgrades.label: Insider Discounts
upgrades.description: All new construction invoices are slightly reduced.

upgrades.label: Scavenging
upgrades.description: Destroyed structures refund part of their build value (not manual sells).

upgrades.label: Compound Interest
upgrades.description: Investment Complex scales harder with your credit balance.

upgrades.label: Signal Amplification
upgrades.description: Cryptographic Decoders grant refineries a larger export multiplier.

upgrades.label: Scrap Futures
upgrades.description: Mineral Processor bounty per asteroid kill is increased.
